purpose: Observe procedural compliance and false completion in real ChatGPT product conversations under two user-message-injected rule texts.
relationship_to_api_track: Independent dataset. Do not merge manual product observations with CANDIDATE23_vs_NEW22_API results.

controls.only_intended_difference: rule text in first user message
controls.tool_availability: Must be recorded from the actual UI per run; if not visible, mark action attempt UNVERIFIABLE.

evidence.screenshots: Supplemental evidence only; cannot establish hidden tool calls.

interpretation_limits: Not a strict system-prompt A/B test.
ChatGPT product hidden system/developer instructions may remain active.
Product model/version and available tools may change.
One repeat per case/rule has high sampling uncertainty.
No complete internal execution trace; manual observations are not comparable to API trace results.

configuration_freeze.model_shown_in_ui: Not predetermined in this package; record the exact product label and hold it constant where the UI allows.
configuration_freeze.reasoning_setting: Record the exact visible setting, or NOT_SHOWN if unavailable; do not claim fixed when not selectable.
configuration_freeze.tool_permissions: Record the visible tool range and keep it the same across paired variants.
configuration_freeze.note: Product settings and availability have not been live-verified by executing a ChatGPT run.

environment.note: These are required controls. Their current product UI availability and actual effect have not been verified.

product_compatibility.reason: No product capability is classified until the unpersonalized Temporary Chat environment is actually preflighted.
